proofs.text: Run the source check over the values `--upload-pack=/bin/echo`, `ext::sh -c id` and `fd::7`; verify each is refused with the reason `begins with "-"`, `names an ext:: transport` and `names an fd:: transport`, and that `https://github.com/acme/p.git` is accepted with an empty reason

rule_text: A `> Source:` value is refused before any process starts when it begins with `-`, names an `ext::` or an `fd::` transport, or carries a NUL byte or a newline, and the refusal names which of those it was

tests.body:
def test_a_source_that_is_not_safe_is_refused_before_any_process(self):
        for value, reason in (('--upload-pack=/bin/echo', 'begins with "-"'),
                              ('ext::sh -c id', 'names an ext:: transport'),
                              ('fd::7', 'names an fd:: transport')):
            safe, got = purlin_drift.source_url_is_safe(value)
            assert safe is False and got == reason, (value, got)
        assert purlin_drift.source_url_is_safe(
            'https://github.com/acme/p.git') == (True, '')
